vulnerability.name: USN-8948-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled out-of-memory conditions while processing requests. A remote attacker could use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-109618)  It was discovered that PHP incorrectly managed internal request state across worker reuse. A remote attacker could use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-109619)

statements.status_notes: PHP could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted network traffic.
